newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 8.53 pct at Italy lira repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 8.53 pct at Italy lira repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 5.5 trillion lire 15-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 8.53 percent, compared with 8.50 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.55 percent against 8.52 percent at the last repurchase pact for 3.0 trillion lire and seven days on September 12.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on October 1. The Bank said it received 34 bids of which five were met in full and four in part.
